scope: Chengdu visitor information: official primary-source review for Chengdu Museum and Sanxingdui Museum; People’s Park and Kuanzhai Alleys remain unresolved pending primary sources.

confirmed.admission: Free general admission; special exhibitions may be ticketed
confirmed.booking: Official reservation required; official 2025 notice says official WeChat account only, no authorised third-party platforms
confirmed.passport: Official notices state passport holders must exchange at the ticket consultation/service window; 2024 notice says overseas visitors can use email reservation via the foreign-language booking system. Current availability of email route should be reconfirmed.
confirmed.hours: Tue-Thu and Sun 09:00-17:00, last entry 16:30; Fri-Sat 09:00-20:30, last entry 20:00; Monday closed except public holidays

confirmed.bookingRelease: 20:00 daily, up to 5 days in advance; holiday release notices may vary
confirmed.foreignVisitors: Inbound-tourist booking channel; original passport required at ticket centre for exchange
confirmed.hours: Exhibition halls 08:30-18:00, ticket checking stops 17:00; selected holiday/school-break extended hours 08:30-20:00, extended entry 17:00-18:00
confirmed.closed: Chinese New Year’s Eve, except temporary notices

records.name: People’s Park
notes: Phase 32 later reviewed secondary references; admission, hours and booking remain unverified from primary sources.

records.name: Kuanzhai Alleys
records.notes: Free public district and 24-hour access claims remain secondary-source only; individual venue hours and charges vary. Do not elevate to official confirmation.
